column2: Buddhi is of the nature of determination; this is its subtle form. Hiranyagarbha is the thread-self (sutratman), known by its effects.
The gross elements arise from the un-quintupled subtle elements; from the quintupled elements the cosmic egg (Brahmanda) was born.
The gross body, known to all the world, is the one with feet and other limbs; the quintupled elements, their effects, and what abides in them.
All the bodies of living beings are called gross. The wise declare the body, abiding in the Supreme Self, to be threefold.
You who pass into both bodies, and the individual self, are one; by the statement of non-difference, Brahman alone has entered the two bodies.
Like the sun reflected in water, the jiva sustains the vital breath and the rest; the jiva is known as the witness of waking, dream and deep sleep.
